problemStatement.plain: Generalizes divisibility rules to arbitrary bases: for b ≥ 3, (b-1) | n iff (b-1) | digit_sum_b(n). Covers hexadecimal (mod 15), octal (mod 7), factor tests, and cross-base divisibility. All 15 theorems fully verified.

insights: base_mod_pred: b % (b-1) = 1 for b >= 3, proved via Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod
factor_mod: b % d = 1 when d >= 2 and d | (b-1), proved via Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left
Universal (b-1) rule applies to any base, not just 10
Cross-base divisibility: 3|n testable in decimal, hex, or any base with 3|(b-1)
Hex mod-15 test works, plus factor tests for mod 3 and mod 5
